name: Abaújszántó (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the town arms of Abaújszántó: a blue shield with a yellow figure, with a helm, a sabre crest and red and yellow mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Abaújszántó arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
